BiblicalUsage: Beah means an entrance, a doorway into a building, and it appears once, when Ezekiel is told to lift up his eyes toward the north at the entry of the altar gate.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the doorway is where the vision begins, because Ezekiel has to look through the gate before he sees the abominations within.
